prerequisites: Recommended: Having passed the subjects corresponding to the basic training competencies in Physics and Mathematics: B01. Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge on: linear algebra, geometry, differential geometry, differential and integral calculus, differential and partial differential equations, numerical methods, numerical algorithmics, statistics and optimization. B02. Understanding and mastery of basic concepts on the general laws of mechanics, thermodynamics, fields and waves, and electromagnetism, and their application to solving engineering problems. Specifically, the recommended minimum knowledge is: In Mathematics: Interpolation of one and several variables, partial derivatives, gradient of a scalar field, integrals, concept of limit, boundary conditions in partial differential equations, Laplace and Fourier transforms, Taylor series expansion, resolution of linear and non-linear equation systems, matrix resolution of equation systems. In Physics: Concept of energy, power, mass, absolute and relative pressure, temperature, density, specific volume, specific heats, enthalpy and entropy. Unit systems for each of the above concepts and unit changes to the International System and others.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of applied thermodynamics and heat transfer. Basic principles and their application to solving engineering problems.
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling learning new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Problem-solving ability.
Ability to apply knowledge in practice.
Ability of analysis and synthesis.
Competence in the critical contextualization of knowledge, establishing interrelations with social, economic, and environmental problems, local and/or global.
Competence in the sustainable use of resources and in preventing negative impacts on the natural and social environment.
Competence in participation in community processes that promote sustainability.
Competence in the application of ethical principles related to sustainability values in personal and professional behavior.
Sensitivity to environmental issues.
Capacity for critical reasoning.
Know how to establish the necessary hypotheses and apply the laws of heat transfer to pose and define the expressions that will allow obtaining temperatures and heat fluxes in practical applications.
Know how to perform the thermal analysis of heat exchangers.
Know the fundamental laws governing heat transfer phenomena.
Know the methodologies for solving heat transfer problems.
Know the different types of heat exchangers and their applications.
Know and obtain the characteristic properties of thermal fluids.
Know and be able to apply the fundamentals of Thermodynamics to the main thermal processes and equipment.
